Build or modify a set of rink dimensions

Source: R/dimensions.R
rink_dimensions.Rd

Starts from an existing set of rink dimensions and overrides single fields, checking that each override is a known field and a single finite number. Typical uses: matching your data's coordinate frame (e.g. origin_x = -30, origin_y = -15 for centre-ice-origin IIHF data) or drawing a non-standard rink.

Usage

rink_dimensions(base = IIHF, ...)

Arguments

base

The dimensions to start from, e.g. IIHF or NHL.

...

Named fields to override, e.g. width = 26.

Value

A named list of rink dimensions, usable wherever gghockey takes dimensions.

See also

rink_dims

Examples

# IIHF rink with the origin at centre ice
centred <- rink_dimensions(IIHF, origin_x = -30, origin_y = -15)

# A narrower 60 x 26 m rink
narrow <- rink_dimensions(IIHF, width = 26)
